🎁 PERSONALISATION STUDIO 🎁
Edit the values in the boxes below to customize your birthday card:
• GreetingTitle: Main celebration heading (e.g. 🎉 Happy Birthday, Sam! (8) 🎉)
• BirthdayMessage: Personal wish message
• SpokenGreeting: Full warm voice greeting read aloud by speech synthesis
• RecipientName: Name of recipient
• Age: Number
• BackgroundColor: Canvas backdrop hue (78=Midnight Indigo, 55=Emerald Teal, 85=Plum)
• CakeColor: Sponge Hue (45=Mint, 16=Vanilla, 95=Strawberry, 10=Chocolate)
• IcingColor: Accent Ribbon Hue (28=Gold, 95=Rose Pink, 60=Sky Blue)
• Instrument: Musical timbre (vibraphone, piano, celeste, flute)
